title: 夜行计划：三前景素材与N机器分工（人工编写示例）
request: 制作雨夜赛博朋克竖版海报：一只橙色机甲猫为主体，右上方增加一架小型青色侦察无人机，右下方增加一个小型橙色能源箱。背景、猫、无人机、能源箱分别生成后逐层合成，标题“夜行计划”用字体排版。按N台可用机器动态分工，不增加其他对象。

visual.style: 电影感写实概念视觉；机械结构可信，材质细节清晰，避免卡通比例。
visual.palette: 深海军蓝与青色构成夜景；橙色机甲主体为暖色焦点；标题为暖白色。
visual.lighting: 左前方暖橙色橱窗光为主光，右后方青色霓虹为轮廓光；阴影朝右后方。各图层保持同样方向与色温。
visual.camera: 接近猫眼高度的低机位，轻微仰视，三分之四正面；约50mm等效视角，垂直线基本稳定，地面透视通向画面上部中央。
visual.composition: 2:3竖版。上方约20%为低细节标题区；机甲猫位于中下部，朝镜头偏左；两侧建筑形成框景，湿路面占底部。 右上方安排小型青色无人机，右下方安排低矮橙色能源箱，两者都与猫的完整轮廓分离。
constraints: 只包含一只橙色机甲猫、一架青色无人机、一个橙色能源箱；背景不重复生成它们。
猫的耳朵、四肢和尾巴完整，机械关节和金属壳体结构连续。
“夜行计划”只通过text_layers原样排版，所有生成素材保持无可读文案。
背景、主体使用相同低机位与左暖右冷光照，不擅自改变主体数量。

full_image_prompt.positive_zh: 一张2:3竖版电影海报的无字视觉底图。深夜的赛博朋克城市刚下过雨，湿润沥青把两侧青色与暖橙色霓虹拉成长条倒影。中下部一只橙色机甲猫以三分之四正面朝镜头偏左站立，左前爪略向前，耳朵竖起，尾巴沿右侧轻弯。橙色搪瓷金属外壳带细小擦痕，关节处露出深灰机械结构，眼部是柔和青色光。左前方暖橙色橱窗照亮其脸和胸部，右后方青色霓虹勾勒耳朵与背部边缘。低机位接近猫眼高度，50mm等效视角，背景建筑垂直线稳定，远处灯光被细雨和薄雾柔化。上方约20%保持深蓝色低细节空间，供后期绘制标题；不生成标题本身。 猫右上方有一架小型青色侦察无人机，右下方有一个低矮橙色能源箱，都是用户明确要求的独立对象；不遮挡猫和标题。
full_image_prompt.positive_en: A text-free visual plate for a 2:3 vertical cinematic poster. A cyberpunk city at night just after rain, wet asphalt stretching cyan and warm orange neon into long reflections. In the lower middle stands exactly one orange mechanized cat in a front three-quarter view, turned slightly toward camera left. Its left front paw is a little forward, ears upright, tail gently curving on its right. The orange enamel metal armor has fine scratches, dark gray mechanical joints remain visible, and its eyes emit a soft cyan glow. A warm orange storefront at front left lights the face and chest; cyan neon from rear right rims the ears and back. The camera is low, near the cat's eye level, with a 50mm-equivalent perspective and stable vertical building lines. Light rain and thin haze soften distant lights. Reserve the upper fifth as a quiet dark navy area for typography added later. Render the scene without lettering. Place exactly one small cyan scout drone above and to the cat's right, and one low orange power case at bottom right, separated from the cat silhouette and title area.
full_image_prompt.negative: duplicate cat, cartoon anatomy, cropped ears, cropped tail, extra legs, floating paws, inconsistent lighting, illegible lettering, watermark
acceptance: 一只橙色机甲猫，写实机械结构与指定姿态一致。
竖版构图与标题留白清晰，生成底图无文字。
主光、轮廓光、地面透视一致。
无人机和能源箱各一个，均不遮猫或标题。

background.positive_zh: 只生成雨夜城市环境底图，768×1152竖版。狭窄赛博朋克街道，两侧深色建筑和抽象发光面板形成框景；不出现人物、猫、动物或车辆中心主体。近景湿沥青带细小积水与破碎反光，中下部中央保留一块连续、没有杂物遮挡的路面，供后期放置机甲猫。街道透视通向上部中央，镜头在接近猫眼高度的低机位，视角约50mm，建筑垂线保持稳定。画面左侧暖橙色橱窗光、右后侧青色霓虹；细雨与远处薄雾降低背景对比。上方20%深海军蓝区域只保留少量朦胧灯光，为暖白标题留出可读空间。所有面板采用抽象色块，不生成可读字符。 无人机与能源箱也使用独立图层，底图不要生成这两个对象。
background.positive_en: Generate only the environment plate, a 768 by 1152 vertical rainy cyberpunk street at night. Dark buildings and abstract glowing panels frame both sides. Keep the scene free of people, cats, animals, and hero vehicles. Wet asphalt in the foreground contains small puddles and broken neon reflections. Leave an uninterrupted clear patch of road in the central lower part for a cat to be composited later. The street perspective converges toward the upper center. Use a low camera near cat-eye height, a 50mm-equivalent perspective, and stable vertical building lines. Warm orange storefront light comes from the left; cyan neon comes from rear right. Fine rain and distant haze soften background contrast. Keep the upper fifth predominantly dark navy and low in detail so warm white typography can be added later. Panels contain abstract colored shapes rather than readable characters. The scout drone and power case will also be separate assets; do not include them in the background.
background.negative: cat, animal, person, central vehicle, central obstacle, title, readable text, watermark, daylight, fisheye distortion, drone, power case
acceptance: 背景不含猫和重复主角，中央下部可放主体。
上方标题区保持暗色低细节，未生成文字。
暖橙左光、青色右后光、低机位透视符合共同约定。

foreground.positive_zh: 单独生成一只完整橙色机甲猫作为抠图素材。三分之四正面，朝镜头偏左，站姿稳定，左前爪略向前；耳朵竖起，尾巴沿身体右侧轻弯，四肢数量正确且所有外轮廓留在图内。橙色搪瓷金属壳体具有细小擦痕，胸口与关节处露出深灰机械结构，青色发光双眼。低机位接近猫眼高度，约50mm等效视角。左前方暖橙色主光照亮脸与胸部，右后方青色轮廓光勾勒背部与耳朵。采用单纯中性灰背景，与猫的轮廓形成充分对比，不要街道、霓虹面板或其他物体。主体占画面大部分但不裁切，便于后续真实抠图或分割；不要把画出的棋盘格当作透明。
foreground.positive_en: Generate one complete orange mechanized cat as an isolated cutout asset. Front three-quarter view turned slightly toward camera left, stable standing pose with the left front paw a little forward. Ears upright, tail gently curved along its right side, correct limb count, every part of the silhouette fully inside the frame. Orange enamel metal armor shows fine scratches; dark gray mechanisms are exposed at the chest and joints; both eyes glow cyan. Use a low camera near cat-eye height and a 50mm-equivalent perspective. Warm orange key light from front left illuminates the face and chest, with a cyan rim from rear right along the ears and back. Place the subject on a simple neutral gray field with clear silhouette contrast, without a street, neon panels, or extra objects. Let the cat fill most of the frame while keeping every extremity visible. This asset will require actual alpha, a segmentation mask, or background removal; do not render a checkerboard pattern.
foreground.negative: multiple cats, cropped ears, cropped paws, cropped tail, extra limbs, fused joints, complex background, street, text, checkerboard, watermark
acceptance: 仅一只橙色机甲猫，耳朵、四肢、尾巴完整。
姿态、金属结构、相机角度与共同光照相符。
交付真实透明alpha或白主体黑背景mask；普通RGB输出需配置rembg。

placement.instructions: 按alpha范围裁切透明留白，保持猫的比例缩放到432×640框，水平居中、底部对齐，猫落在画面中下部偏左，为右侧独立素材留空间。不自动生成倒影或重打光。
acceptance: 前景边缘没有灰底残留或明显光晕。
主体保持比例，未拉伸；爪部贴近指定路面落点。
标题区域空出，整体光照与透视没有明显冲突。

prompt.positive_zh: 一架小型青色金属侦察无人机，两个封闭式旋翼罩与中央圆形摄像头清晰，三分之四正面偏左视角，全部旋翼轮廓完整。它将出现在雨夜城市的机甲猫右上方，与猫保持同一电影感写实材质。左前方暖橙色光在壳体上留下窄高光，右后方青色光勾边；相机轻微仰视。单纯中性灰对比背景，没有猫、街道或第二架无人机。主体轮廓清晰，供真实分割或抠图使用。
prompt.positive_en: One small cyan metal scout drone with two enclosed rotor shrouds and one central circular camera, shown in a front three-quarter view angled slightly left. Keep every rotor silhouette complete. It will appear above and to the right of a mechanized cat in a rainy city, sharing the same cinematic realistic material treatment. Warm orange light from front left makes narrow highlights on the shell, and cyan rear-right light rims the edges. View it with a slight upward camera angle. Use a simple contrasting neutral gray background, without a cat, street, or second drone. Keep a clear silhouette for actual segmentation or background removal.
prompt.negative: multiple drones, cropped rotors, cat, street, text, watermark, checkerboard
acceptance: 恰好一架无人机，旋翼和机身完整。
暖左光、青色右后光与主画面一致。
有真实alpha或mask，或由配置执行抠图。

placement.instructions: 无人机放在猫右上方，不与猫耳重叠，保持比例，在目标框内水平居中、底部对齐。此层在猫之后叠放。
acceptance: 无人机不遮挡标题或猫耳。
尺寸比猫明显小，没有灰色背景残留。

prompt.positive_zh: 一个低矮橙色工业能源箱，横向矩形轮廓，深灰加固包角，顶部有折叠提手，前面有小块青色状态灯但没有文字或数字。完整三分之四正面偏左视角，接近地面的低机位，金属搪瓷材质带少量雨滴和擦痕。左前方暖橙色主光、右后方青色边缘光，与机甲猫和雨夜城市一致。单纯中性灰对比背景，仅一个能源箱，四周留出少量完整轮廓边距，便于实际抠图。
prompt.positive_en: One low orange industrial power case with a horizontal rectangular silhouette, dark gray reinforced corners, a folded top handle, and a small cyan status light on the front without letters or digits. Show a complete front three-quarter view angled slightly left from a low near-ground camera. Enamel metal has a few raindrops and scratches. Match warm orange front-left key light and cyan rear-right rim light to the cat and rainy city. Use a simple contrasting neutral gray background with exactly one case and a small margin around its complete silhouette for actual cutout processing.
prompt.negative: multiple cases, cropped handle, cat, drone, readable text, digits, watermark, complex background
acceptance: 只有一个横向能源箱，包角与提手完整。
状态灯没有文案，材质与共同光照一致。
具备真实alpha或mask，或由配置执行抠图。

placement.instructions: 作为最后一个前景图层放在右下方，底部对齐y=1048，保持比例，不与猫爪或标题重叠。
acceptance: 能源箱位于指定右下区域，尺寸明显小于猫。
轮廓无灰底，落点和透视与路面协调。

assumptions: 本文件为人工编写的创作计划示例，不是真实LLM响应，也没有执行GPU出图。
用户未指定像素尺寸，示例选768×1152的2:3竖版；实际工作流需支持这些尺寸。
用户未指定画风细节，采用偏写实电影概念视觉；标题按“夜行计划”四字排版。
字体由使用者配置，需支持全部中文；普通RGB前景默认通过配置中的rembg抠图，首次使用可能下载模型。
没有承诺自动生成精确接触阴影、倒影或局部重绘；画面融合需查看真实结果。
本示例有背景加三个独立前景任务；是否同时运行由实际worker角色、数量与capacity决定，不要求恰好四台机器。
